frozen: written by make_predictions_e114.py from the sources below and committed with E114.md before the #community-lab claim and before any E114 device access; any change after it goes in E114.md's Amendments, dated, before the data it touches

e84_firmware.source: E84 README amendment A1 and ident/ident-154200.out

e84_die_line.what: die = a + b x board W over E84's 13 sustained runs (per-run sus_w_mean, sus_die_mean), E84 corrections-check C1

expected.what: context, never a verdict: where each E114 cell mean is expected to fall (E84's single run, with run-to-run and day-to-day room)

fp16/ones.limit: none (E84's die maxed at 65 C, so a thermal run is possible)

E114-R1.says: E84's single sustained run of each of the five kinds lies inside E114's 95% prediction interval for one new run, on the kernel's sustained rate: mean +- t(0.975, n-1) x sd x sqrt(1 + 1/n) over the kind's E114 runs
E114-R1.pass: >= 4 of 5 kinds inside; FAIL when >= 2 scored kinds are outside; otherwise UNDER-RESOLVED

E114-R2.says: fp16 zeros faster than fp16 random data, sustained, replicated: rho16 = the mean over passes of rate(fp16 zeros, pass p) / rate(fp16 randn, pass p), with its 95% interval t(0.975, n-1) x sd / sqrt(n)
E114-R2.pass: PASS when the interval's lower end >= 1.15; FAIL when its upper end < 1.15; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE; UNDER-RESOLVED below three pairs

E114-R3.says: int8 zeros against int8 full, sustained: rho8 = the mean over passes of rate(int8 zeros, pass p) / rate(int8 full, pass p), with its 95% interval
E114-R3.kind: primary (a reading, scored against the frozen one)
E114-R3.readings: FASTER when the interval's lower end > 1; SLOWER when its upper end < 1; SAME_WITHIN_BAR when it holds 1 and lies inside [0.98, 1.02]; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE; UNDER-RESOLVED below three pairs

E114-R4.says: the limiting test replicates: each E114 run's sustained limit (reduce_e84.py's label, unchanged) equals E84's for its kind (fp16 randn thermal, the other four none)
E114-R4.pass: PASS when at most 1 run of >= 14 differs; FAIL when >= 2 differ; otherwise UNDER-RESOLVED

E114-S1.says: card 0's rho (R2's and R3's statistic) against aifoundry2's ratio of mean sustained rates over its committed runs (E80, E83, E87, E96): delta = rho(card 0) - rho(aifoundry2), 95% interval t(0.975, df) x sqrt(se_c0^2 + se_a2^2), df = the smaller of card 0's pairs and aifoundry2's smaller run count, minus 1; se_a2 by the delta method
E114-S1.readings: ALIKE when the interval lies inside +-bar; DIFFERENT when it excludes 0; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE

expected.fp16: DIFFERENT (card 0 lower: its random fp16 draws less power and throttles less, while both cards' zeros sit near the 800 MHz cap; at three pairs the interval may not resolve it)

context_never_a_verdict: each cell's sampled clock, non-ramp clock, board W, die mean and max, ramp share and limit, with 95% intervals and prediction intervals; E84's single run beside each
pass-paired zeros minus heavy sustained clock per format (E84-P1's form, -10 MHz)
today's heat path against 31 Oct's: each run's die minus E84's die line at its board W, mean and 95% interval
rho as the ratio of the two cells' mean rates, delta-method interval, beside R2's and R3's mean of pass ratios
card 0's idle level per run (idle_w, idle_mhz) and the cooling gate's reading and hold
